contracts.completed_entry: Thin wrapper calls actual retained resources.submit/run_in_executor, records real returned pending Future and registers its observation callback before canonical shield callback. Only after actual healthy entry Future.result retains the browser does it arm real STOP and cancel actual caller. Same-coroutine escaping cancellation is retained; canonical driver receives no browser result. Actual healthy entry Future is separate from actual held cleanup Future. PID/arguments/alive/closed-gate and loop callback progress plus actual model acquisition precede cleanup release.
contracts.shared_cleanup: Existing exact272 exit owner cancels first real held STOP caller. Two fresh canonical exit callers then run while same worker remains held; both entered witnesses, independent call_soon loop progress and both tasks pending precede one actual submitted Future/batch assertion. After release, healthy callers return None or both expose same raw cleanup fault; original cause and canonical report identity remain required. This is coalescing while pending, not perpetual no-retry on completed failure.
contracts.submission_rejection: Only cleanup run_in_executor submission is rejected after successful real entry Future completion; no fake Future/result. Original same-coroutine cancellation must escape with established BrowserLaunchFailures primary/cleanup composition, typed BrowserExitSubmissionFailure retaining exact actual browser and raw RuntimeError, plus original rejection cause. Browser cached exit Future remains None/no cleanup commands or child. Actual submission is restored, actual retained browser is given to canonical cleanup driver, real STOP acquisition/progress and complete closure/model release are required before backup.
contracts.report_order: Existing272 assert_completed verifies canonical fault/Future/cancellation report before retrieving exit worker.exception. Healthy entry result retrieval is separate, explicitly expected healthy. Additional caller results are retrieved after canonical report assertion; no synthesized report/JoinError/Task wrapper.
contracts.backup: Resource cleanup registered before prepare; each additional owner registered before task/child acquisition. Actual browser retained by separate cleanup driver, original/extra/recovery Tasks retained immediately and actual executor Futures remain in original resources ledger. Finite per-phase caller/worker/process/monitor cleanup; unexpected observer/recovery errors retained and original unittest target plus backup error both survive. No fallible await finally replaces a target cause; only known exact controlled fault and requested backup cancellation are recognized.
